#comment: This is an example configuration. Copy to context-priority.json and customize for your project.
#always-include: Files that should ALWAYS be in AI context regardless of task

apps/backend/core/client.py.reason: Critical SDK client - all AI interactions go through this

apps/backend/agents/planner.py.reason: Core planner agent - essential for understanding build pipeline

#high-priority: Core application files most relevant to tasks

apps/backend/context/*.py.reason: Context management system - core to this feature

apps/frontend/src/main/**/*.ts.reason: Electron main process - critical for desktop app

apps/frontend/src/renderer/components/**.reason: UI components - relevant for frontend work

#low-priority: Less relevant unless specifically working on them

apps/frontend/src/renderer/styles/**/*.c.reason: Styling files - only relevant for UI changes

#never-include: Files that should NEVER be in AI context

**/*_test.py.reason: Test files - exclude unless debugging tests

.auto-claude/specs/**/memory/**.reason: Graphiti memory database - not source code
